{{Short description|Indian mathematician and scholar}}
{{Notability|1=Academics|date=September 2022}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=May 2023}}
{{Use Indian English|date=May 2023}}
'''Dishant Mayurbhai Pancholi''' is a professor in the [[Institute of Mathematical Sciences, Chennai]] with research interests in contact and symplectic topology.<ref>{{cite web |title=Dishant Mayurbhai Pancholi |url=https://www.imsc.res.in/dishant_mayurbhai_pancholi |website=The Institute of Mathematical Sciences |access-date=10 November 2021}}</ref> Before taking up the position in The Institute Of Mathematical Sciences in 2016, Pancholi was an assistant professor at [[Chennai Mathematical Institute]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Dishant M. Pancholi |url=https://www.cmi.ac.in/~dishant/ |website=Website of Chennai Mathematical Institute |publisher=Chennai Mathematical Institute |access-date=9 November 2021}}</ref> He is also a von Newmann Fellow at the [[Institute for Advanced Study]] in [[Princeton, New Jersey]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Dishant Mayurbhai Pancholi |url=https://www.ias.edu/scholars/dishant-mayurbhai-pancholi |website=Institute for Advanced Study |date=4 January 2021 |access-date=9 November 2021}}</ref> The Singapore based magazine ''[[Asian Scientist]]'' selected Pancholi in  2020 for their [[Asian Scientist 100]] list as a top researcher in Asia.<ref>{{cite web |title=The Asian Scientist 100 |url=https://www.asianscientist.com/as100#2020 |website=[[Asian Scientist]] |publisher=Wildtype Media Group Pte Ltd |access-date=9 November 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Three Vietnamese female scientists make list of Top 100 Asian researchers |url=https://vir.com.vn/three-vietnamese-female-scientists-make-list-of-top-100-asian-researchers-77151.html |website=Vietnam Investment Review |date=18 June 2020 |publisher=Ministry of Planning and Investment Editor-in-Chief: Le Trong Minh, Govt of Vietnam |access-date=9 November 2021}}</ref> Pancholi was awarded the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]] in Mathematical Sciences in the year 2019.<ref>{{cite web |title=Brief Profile of the Awardee |url=https://ssbprize.gov.in/content/Detail.aspx?AID=555 |website=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology |publisher=CSIR Human Resource Development Group, New Delhi |access-date=10 November 2021}}</ref>

Pancholi obtained his PhD degree from School of Mathematics, [[Tata Institute of Fundamental Research]], [[Mumbai]] in 2006 for a thesis titled "Knots, mapping class groups and Kirby calculus", and MSc degree from [[Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda]], [[Vadodara]] in 1998.{{fact|date=May 2023}}

==Honours and recognitions==
*B M Birla Science prize in 2017 
*[[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]] in Mathematical Sciences in 2019
